nom: Aveeno Positively Radiant Skin Brightening Daily Facial Scrub with Moisture-Rich Soy Extract

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report it exfoliates gently without drying or irritating their skin, with one buying it repeatedly over multiple purchases without any issues.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as not particularly sensitive, oily, or dry still reports a noticeable boost in radiance and a more even-looking complexion within a couple of weeks.
segments.mature: One reviewer who has used it for 25 years, including on her neck and upper chest as she's gotten older, credits it with keeping that skin soft and avoiding the crinkled look she sees in other women that age.

concerns.aging: The only comment on aging comes from a 25-year user who says using it on her neck and upper chest has kept that skin soft and helped her avoid the crinkled look common in that area, though this reflects one person's long-term routine rather than a broader pattern.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report it exfoliates without stripping or drying out their skin, several specifically contrasting it with harsher scrubs that left them dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers, including several with sensitive skin, report no irritation from daily or twice-daily use.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report a brighter, more even-looking complexion, including one who specifically credits it with evening out her complexion as a dark-skinned woman, consistent with the product's brightening claim.
concerns.blemishes: The only comment on breakouts is one reviewer's note that she doesn't break out extra from using it; no reviewer in this set reports the opposite.

aspects.libelle: Watery texture, less gritty than a traditional scrub
Lathers well, only a small amount needed per use
Gentle enough for daily or twice-daily use
Some tubes arrive with a defective, leaking cap
Pleasant, light scent without heavy residue

extraits.titre: Obvious product had been opened and returned.
extraits.texte: Facial scrubs must be treated like cosmetics. They cannot be opened and then resold. I would never put anything on my face that could have been contaminated by a person who could possibly have whatever skin disease. This should never have been sent out.

extraits.titre: Defective bottle cap leaking out cream
extraits.texte: Two of the five tubes have damaged bottle caps that lead to leaking cream. The first picture is the defective item and the second one is perfect top.

extraits.titre: My Daily Glow Staple that Truly Transformed My Skin
extraits.texte: This Aveeno facial scrub has become a true staple in both my morning and evening skincare routine. When I turned 35, I started paying more attention to my overall skin and body care. Without much research, I began using this face wash daily and within just a couple of weeks, I started getting compliments from my mom and sister about how healthy and radiant my skin looked. As a dark-skinned woman, I’ve noticed it really helps even out my complexion and enhance my natural glow. I don’t have particularly sensitive, oily, or dry skin, but this scrub still gave my skin a noticeable boost. What I love most is how refreshed my face feels after using it. It’s not just cleansing, it genuinely feels like a small self-care experience every time I use it. Definitely 100/10 recommend!

extraits.titre: Gentle exfoliant for daily use even after 25 years of use
extraits.texte: You can't buy a better product for your face. I started using this 25 years ago when my favorite face wash from Benefit stopped making it. Aveeno isn't like that. They understand their customer. As I've gotten older I use it in the shower on my neck & upper chest area. It keeps the skin soft & I haven't gotten that crinkled look most women get in that area. It's very gentle on your skin and is a terrific exfoliate without dying your skin or being to rough. I wouldn't use any other skin care to wash with. Save my money for excellent face cream.

extraits.titre: Good for sensitive skin but nice gentle exfoliation
extraits.texte: My fave face wash. It’s exfoliating but in such a nice gentle way. It doesn’t dry you out but makes it feel like it’s doing something without being abrasive. Good for sensitive skin like mine. I’ve bought it multiple times in a row with no issues!

This Aveeno Scrub cleanse and brightens up my skin very well. It lathers up really good. After use my skin always look like it has a beautiful glow to it. It leaves my skin soft, smooth, and moisturized without it feeling dry. It has a very pleasant scent which smells refreshing. I use it every other day because it can be used daily. I'm glad it's for sensitive skin, so it doesn't causes any irritations on my skin.

extraits.titre: Budget friendly but WORTH IT facial cleanser!
extraits.texte: Absolutely one of my favorite go to facial cleansers! I’ve been purchasing this for a few years now. It’s gently on my skin, I never break out extra because of it. My face is always left feeling clean and smooth. Totally recommend!

reserve: With 13 reviews sampled from 4,611 total, some concerns here — aging and blemishes in particular — rest on a single account each, so treat those as directional rather than conclusive.
